proof_attempt_summary: The fixed-smoothness proposal was pivoted to the accepted adaptive phase-diagram topic after collision review. A bounded dyadic salvage proved the matched parent-valid n^-1/5 frontier on beta in [1/3,1], one beta/allocation-independent computable original-record test without log loss, and a two-sided validity penalty using fixed-null benchmarks on [1/2,1]; the math referee passed it. The parent profile below 1/3, fixed profile below 1/2, sharp transitions and full-range simultaneous cost remain explicit open questions, leaving the package at subfield rather than the requested field tier.
tldr:
The lead contribution is the ordinary matched parent-valid minimax plateau theorem for conditional causal-law equality under arbitrary overlap-bounded Borel allocation. For every \(n\ge2^{1024}\) and \(\beta\in[1/3,1]\),
\[
 \frac{n^{-1/5}}{8192}\le\rho_n^{\cup}(\beta)\le2000n^{-1/5}.
\]
One \(\beta\)- and allocation-independent total computable original-record test has size at most \(1/10\) over the full parent null and power at least \(4/5\) at separation \(2000n^{-1/5}\), simultaneously on this interval. The plateau-only simultaneous ratio lies between \(1\) and \(16384000\), so no logarithmic or iterated-logarithmic enlargement is needed there. On \(\beta\in[1/2,1]\), the two-sided parent-validity penalty is
\[
 \frac{n^{2\beta/(4\beta+1)-1/5}}{8192000}
 \le\frac{\rho_n^{\cup}(\beta)}{\rho_n(\beta)}
 \le128000n^{2\beta/(4\beta+1)-1/5}.
\]
This penalty compares validity requirements; it is distinct from simultaneous search.

The older full-range bracket remains secondary supporting content. For \(\beta\in[1/8,1]\), the fixed-null radius lies between \(n^{-2\beta/(4\beta+1)}/64\) and \(2000n^{-u(\beta)}\), where \(u(\beta)=\beta/(\beta+1)\) below \(1/2\) and \(u(\beta)=2\beta/(4\beta+1)\) at and above it. The parent-null radius lies between \(n^{-\min\{2\beta/(4\beta+1),1/5\}}/8192\) and \(2000n^{-4\beta/(28\beta+1)}\). A separate total computable smoothness-independent original-record test has parent-null size at most \(1/10\) and power at least \(4/5\) at separation \(40000L_n^{1/4}n^{-4\beta/(28\beta+1)}\), with \(L_n=2+\lfloor\log_2n\rfloor\), at the same onset. Its grid factor is sufficient and is not proved necessary. The collision-aware parent converse uses constant arm laws with equal means. The remaining open scope is the parent profile on \([1/8,1/3)\), the fixed-null profile below \(1/2\), sharp transition structure, and the full-range simultaneous cost \(\Lambda_n\). The bounded plateau-only ratio does not evaluate \(\Lambda_n\).
